satellites.title: Metal as a Phase
satellites.evidence: 洪範 orders five processes or categories as 水、火、木、金、土. 金 is fourth in that passage, not an element in the modern chemical sense.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: Adamant, Thunderbolt
satellites.evidence: 金剛, “the hardest metal”, renders vajra, the thunderbolt and diamond that cuts and cannot be cut. Kumārajīva titled the Vajracchedikā 金剛般若波羅蜜經.
satellites.caveat: The Five Phases’ 金 and the Buddhist 金剛 share a graph, not a system.
